description: CC tool-running spinner with a multi-word gerund phrase between glyph and ellipsis. Captured 2026-04-30 from a real Install-And-Verify turn. The pre-2026-04-30 single-word regex `[A-Za-z]+…` failed to match this because of the spaces and `+` between the glyph and `…`, leaving the classifier returning 'unknown' on every tick of the turn until the no-spinner-20s safety net flashed the 'check terminal' banner during a healthy thinking turn. Widened gerund body fixes it. Counter is 1m 52s = 112s.
